items.headline: <US Stock Weekly Theme> Energy Storage Systems - TSLA, ENPH, RUN
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle on upward revisions to lithium demand from stationary storage; Benchmark raised 2026 global LCE demand 12% to 2.1 million tons, BESS demand revised from 92,000 to 270,000 tons.

items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle (ALB) to Outperform from Neutral and maintained a $130 price target, citing stronger battery energy storage (BESS) demand that could tighten the lithium market.

items.headline: Xos Inc. - Rocket Thrusters on a Road Car Arrive as EV Makers Split Into Winners and Laggards
items.snippet: Albemarle (NYSE:ALB): On October 12, the most active lithium carbonate contract on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange fell 11.8% to 104,740 yuan per ton, its lowest in nearly ten months; ALB fell 4.2% pre-market. A day later Mizuho upgraded to Outperform with a $130 target.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform with unchanged $130 target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance favorable; ALB is the lowest-cost lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered its price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium up ~67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.
